relations.text: ガス貯蔵施設スティックマン・リッジを共同所有
relations.text_en: Co-owns the Steckman Ridge gas storage facility

source.label: New Jersey Resources 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: Steckman Ridge Steckman Ridge is a Delaware limited partnership, jointly owned and controlled by our subsidiaries and subsidiaries of Enbridge Inc., which built, owns and operates a natural gas storage facility with up to 12 Bcf of working natural gas capacity in Bedford County, Pennsylvania.
